_comment: Central CI risk policy. scripts/ci/classify_changes.py is the sole interpreter.

risk_tiers.R0: Docs/audit/marketing only — required checks report green without Postgres, Redis, or Playwright.
risk_tiers.R1: Single-stack light work — unit/lint on one stack; no backend integration DB; storefront e2e skipped unless e2e triggers fire.
risk_tiers.R2: Backend or cross-cutting code — full backend lint + Postgres/Redis pytest with cov-fail-under=68.
risk_tiers.FULL: Conservative — everything applicable (escape hatch, unknown paths, workflow edits, ci:full label).
